, the original Prime Designate.]] , the self-proclaimed Prime Designate.]] Prime Designate (or prime designate) is a title for the ruler of Azeroth's titan-forged keepers, charged by the Pantheon of Order with watching over the planet. The Pantheon originally appointed Odyn the Prime Designate, but he gave up the position upon breaking off from the other keepers in ancient times. Loken later made himself the new Prime Designate after betraying the other keepers and retained the office until his death.

Primal Storms are events happening in the Dragon Isles level-up zones, switching between the Waking Shores, Ohn'ahran Plains, the Azure Span, and Thaldraszus, with two storms up every three hours and they last for two hours followed by a one-hour inactive period. At the event location, Primalists will spawn and local mobs will be empowered by the event. Storms can show up in either of the following locations, and cycle between a type of invasion from Storm, Earth, Fire, and Water. * Waking Shores: Obsidian Citadel, Dragonbane Keep, or Scalecracker Keep * Ohn'ahran Plains: Nokhudon Hold * Azure Span: Brackenhide Hollow, Cobalt Assembly, or south of Camp Nowhere * Thaldraszus: Tyrhold

]] The Prismatic Blades, also referred to as the Prismatic Blades of Quel'Serrar, prismatic dragon blades, or Ancient Dragonforged Blades are ancient weapons made well before the War of the Ancients, when the five main dragonflights lived in harmony. Mortal champions have long used these weapons to combat evil.

Warbringer Rava was one of Iridikron's favorite wingleaders during the War of the Scaleborn. Her scales are described as gleaming like obsidian prior to the war, but as being like cracked stone during the later portions of the war. Rava and her lieutenants, Ryanog and Kagoznos, presented Iridikron with the evidence that the dragonflights had been using the titan-forged to steal primal dragon eggs from their nests. Later in the war, she led the battalion of rockfuries sieging Algeth'ar Academy, until she was driven from it by Malygos and Cysanz after his defection from the Primalist cause. Her wingleaders were killed in front of her by Cysanz during this battle and she swore her revenge. Duri

The Realm First! achievements are special feats of strength awarded to the first player or group on a realm that accomplish specific milestones. These achievements were highly competitive and could only be earned once per realm. There will be a server-wide notification for each achievement as they are completed. Most of the achievements haven't been a thing since , but they do continue to be introduced as Keystone Hero and Keystone Master achievements for groups. Guilds continued to receive these achievements for being the first guild to defeat a raid boss up to with the Hall of Fame achievements taking over starting with .

The Rebellious Cliffs is an area located in Thaldraszus. Directly buttressing the edge of Valdrakken, this region of cliffs and caves was inhabited mostly by the Flightless drakonid engaged in rebellion against the authority of the Valdrakken Accord. Although the Accord initially pursued the rebels violently, they were eventually able to be persuaded to lay down their arms and come back into the fold, primarily with the help of Maldra Flametongue.

The Reins of the Frostsaber were an epic frostsaber mount sold by Lelanai in Darnassus before patch 1.4.0. This item was removed from Lelanai's inventory with the addition of new, more impressive-looking epic mounts. Players who'd already bought a Frostsaber could exchange it for one of the new mounts via the Frostsaber Replacement quest. The mount was later renamed to Ancient Frostsaber. Having this mount awards the Old School Ride Feat of Strength.
